notice: Pilot issue. Claude assembled it by hand from web searches on 30 September 2026 to preview the layout; items span recent months rather than one week, and notes are based on headlines and snippets only. The automated weekly sweep starts once the GitHub repository is set up.
digest: This pilot gathers the threads the sweep will follow weekly. The African Union's credit rating agency is moving towards launch, and the press is already asking whether investors will trust it. New Southern financial centres in Nairobi and Ho Chi Minh City are under pressure to show real firms and real deals. On the scholarly side, RIPE and Finance and Space continue to extend the financial-subordination framework, to climate finance and to post-socialist banking, which makes both useful foils for the project's own hypothesis.
